Package org.spaceinvaders.accounts

Class AccountStore

java.lang.Object
org.spaceinvaders.accounts.AccountStore
public final class AccountStore extends Object
AccountStore.java
A small self-hosted replacement for the Firebase Authentication + Firestore setup the game originally used. Accounts are kept in a JSON file (data/accounts.json by default, override with -Dnebula.accounts=path) with salted PBKDF2 password hashes. Signing in returns a random session token that the client sends back to fetch its profile.
Since:
11/13/2024
